claim: The first emission filter wheel serves the red camera and the second serves the blue camera. The operator stated this from memory, with the word probably, and the blue half is the complementary half of the same recalled claim.
validity_conditions: This instrument as configured on 2026-09-17, stated from memory rather than read (operator_recall:kyuhwan_20260917), which is why this is E5 and not E3 while every neighbouring claim about the unit is E3. Not to be promoted by corroboration: a spectral splitter puts one wheel on each output arm, which is consistent with this mapping but is not a reading of it. If the mapping is inverted, two-colour data is labelled wrong and nothing raises an error. Settled by one acquisition: move one wheel and see which camera's image changes.
